# AlorAir Crawl Space

> > Commercial-grade dehumidifiers and moisture control solutions for crawl spaces, basements, and whole-house applications with smart home integration.

AlorAir specializes in energy-efficient dehumidification equipment for residential and commercial moisture control. The site offers multiple product lines including the Sentinel and Galaxy dehumidifier series, ventilation systems, air filtration, and encapsulation supplies for comprehensive crawl space and basement solutions.

## Key Topics

- Sentinel HD55 dehumidifier
- Galaxy 60P dehumidifier
- Crawl space dehumidification
- Basement moisture control
- Wi-Fi smart dehumidifiers
- HVAC integration
- Energy Star certified
- Humidity control
- Crawl space ventilation
- Condensate pump systems
- Air filtration systems
- Crawl space encapsulation
- Commercial wholesale
- Water damage restoration
- Moisture removal
